Confirmed. Full picture assembled.

q30.

Memo lifecycle events that dispatch webhooks (all defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`):

- `memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:15) — called from `memo_service.go:157` on memo creation
- `memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:20) — called from `memo_update_helpers.go:67` on memo update
- `memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:25) — called from `memo_service.go:562` on memo deletion
- `memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:30) — called from `memo_service_comments.go:119` on comment creation

**Convergence:** The first three (created/updated/deleted) route through the shared helper `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (memo_service_webhooks.go:48), while the comment-created path builds its payload inline; all four ultimately call `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), which enqueues the payload onto a bounded channel (`asyncPostQueue`, buffer 128, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`). Four worker goroutines spawned in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`) drain that queue and call the actual HTTP-delivery function `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`), which builds the signed request (Standard Webhooks HMAC signature) and sends it via the shared SSRF-guarded `safeClient`.

So all memo webhook events converge for delivery at **`webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`**, fed by the async queue/worker pool starting at `PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`).
